name: IntakeQ / PracticeQ
short_description: Flexible practice management platform known for customizable intake forms, scheduling, and clinical documentation for health and wellness practitioners.
long_description: IntakeQ is a cloud-based practice management platform that started as a digital intake form solution and evolved into a comprehensive EHR under the PracticeQ brand. Founded in 2014 in Ontario, Canada, the platform serves mental health therapists, counselors, nutritionists, chiropractors, and other health and wellness practitioners. IntakeQ is particularly known for its highly customizable intake forms, questionnaires, and assessments that can be branded and automated. PracticeQ extends the platform with full EHR capabilities including scheduling, clinical notes with templates, HIPAA-compliant telehealth, secure messaging, insurance billing, and a patient portal. The platform includes e-prescribing capabilities and supports outcome measurement with customizable questionnaires including PHQ-9 and GAD-7. IntakeQ/PracticeQ emphasizes ease of use, automation, and flexibility, making it popular with practices that have specific workflow requirements or want highly customized client intake experiences.
one_liner: The customizable intake forms platform that grew into a flexible mental health practice management solution.
best_for: Practices wanting highly customizable intake forms and questionnaires
Mental health clinicians needing flexible documentation templates
Solo and small practices seeking affordable all-in-one solution
not_for: Practices needing specialized addiction treatment features
Organizations requiring full revenue cycle management services

seo.title: IntakeQ / PracticeQ: Mental Health Practice EHR
seo.meta_description: IntakeQ and PracticeQ offer flexible practice management with customizable intake forms, scheduling, notes, and telehealth for mental health practitioners.

faqs.a: IntakeQ for intake forms starts at $49.90/month. PracticeQ (full EHR) starts at $59/month for solo practitioners and scales with practice size. A 14-day free trial is available. Annual billing provides discounts.

faqs.q: What is the difference between IntakeQ and PracticeQ?
faqs.a: IntakeQ is the intake forms and questionnaire product, while PracticeQ is the full EHR platform built on top of IntakeQ. PracticeQ includes all IntakeQ features plus scheduling, clinical notes, telehealth, billing, and a patient portal.
Yes, both IntakeQ and PracticeQ are HIPAA compliant with BAA available. The platform uses encryption, secure data centers, and follows healthcare security best practices.

faqs.q: Can I customize intake forms in IntakeQ?
faqs.a: Yes, IntakeQ is known for highly customizable intake forms. You can create branded questionnaires, consent forms, and assessments using a drag-and-drop builder. Templates can include conditional logic and scoring.

faqs.q: Does IntakeQ support EPCS for controlled substances?
faqs.a: Yes, IntakeQ/PracticeQ supports EPCS (Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances) via ScriptSure integration. The ePrescribing add-on costs $65/month per prescriber and includes ID.me identity verification. DEA two-user approval is required per federal regulations.
